About Kimber

A route you can count on

We're a local lawn and landscape crew serving Oviedo, Winter Springs and the rest of Seminole County. Most of our work is recurring maintenance — the same yards, the same schedule, done right every time.

When a yard needs more than upkeep, we handle sod and mulch, fresh plantings and clean bed borders too. Either way, you deal with the same people who show up to do the work.

  • On a schedule you can set your watch by — "always on schedule" is our most-repeated review.
  • Every visit ends with the yard trimmed, edged and cleaned up.
  • Fair, upfront pricing and quick responses when you call.
